raw_caption: On August 27, 2026, Shakarganj Foundation in collaboration with Asian Continental Pharma organized a successful Free General Medical Camp at Mobile Free Dispensary Gilmala. Dr Muhammad Aamir  examined 53 patients. All patients received free-of-cost medications from medical camp. Shakarganj Foundation extends its heartfelt gratitude to the Management of Asian Continental Pharma for conducting the Free General Medical Camp at Mobile Free Dispensary Gilmala.
